#### Veeam

**Backup**

This dashboard gives visibility into Backup Event Forwarding in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total and failed backup events, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces top backup jobs and virtual machines. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a backup-operations view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
